notes_for_editor: Story is about 105 words, slightly under the 120-word floor. Only the list row is tower-specific; searches (two) and cache checks found no history, staffing or fate for this site. Do not confuse with the Edison, New Jersey fire tower site (data/raw/fflos/firetower.org/lookouts/us/nj/edison-fire-tower-site), which is a different structure. The list point (31.56071, -84.72867) is roughly 0.9 km east of the Wikipedia town-centre coordinates (31.56083, -84.73806); this is my calculation, not a source statement. The register codes BLL and gfc are not explained by the list. Record's registers are consistent with the list. Human review recommended before publishing.
